messages:
ayana: Heads-up: SA region showing a spike in GPU warm-pool churn since ~06:20 UTC. Nodes spawn, attempt cert issuance, then fail and retry. Looks like the cert-issuer can't reach the CA endpoint. Warm-pool kept scaling and cost is mounting.

vince: Any error samples from the issuer or instance agent?

ayana: issuer log snippet: 
```
[2026-07-12T06:21:03Z] cert-issuer: POST https://private-ca.internal/v1/sign 403 -> EndpointPolicyViolation
[2026-07-12T06:21:03Z] cert-issuer: remote error: endpoint returned access denied, payload dropped
```
and node-agent: 
```
[2026-07-12T06:21:15Z] bootstrap: waiting for cert -> timeout waiting for CA response
[2026-07-12T06:21:15Z] agent: attestation failed, aborting bootstrap
```

ops-bot: Alert: 64 nodes failing cert issuance in south-america-1 (>5m). Warm-pool scaling elevated.

rachel: I can see VPC endpoint policy for the CA was tightened in the 02:00 maintenance window to only allow assumeRole from principal arn:aws:iam::555:role/secure-ca-client. Our infra uses a cross-account issuance flow via role arn:aws:iam::666:role/infra-cert-proxy. The new endpoint policy blocks that.

vince: That explains 403. Did we also change IAM role boundaries recently?

rachel: Yes, earlier this week we pushed a role-boundary update that restricts principals that can assume infra roles from non-prod partitions. It might be rejecting the proxy's assume. I also see audit-exporter sampling lowered to 10% in SA at 01:50 to save bandwidth; the CA rate limiter is using audit events for anti-abuse and when it sees low sampling it delays issuance for retries. So that's three moving parts.

billing-bot: Quick cost estimate: if churn continues at current rate, projected extra ~520 GPU-minutes in 45m (~$780). Recommend immediate mitigation.

avana: (typo) ayana: Plan: 1) temporarily widen CA VPC endpoint policy to allow arn:aws:iam::666:role/infra-cert-proxy 2) add a short-lived exception to the role boundary for the proxy assume 3) bump audit-exporter sampling back to 100% for south-america-1 4) pause warm-pool autoscaling for 20m and restart stuck agents in small batches. Who can own 1 & 2?

vince: I can apply the endpoint policy patch and coordinate with security to add the boundary exception. Starting endpoint change now.

ayana: I'll toggle the sampling and pause autoscaling. Patch commands I'm using: ``aws ec2 modify-vpc-endpoint --vpc-endpoint-id vpce-0a1b2c3 --policy-document file://open-ca-endpoint.json --region south-america-1`` and ``aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name sa-warm-pool --max-size 120 --min-size 20 --region south-america-1``

ops-bot: Note: INC-9002 created: SA cert issuance blocked by VPC endpoint policy + role-boundary + audit sampling.

vince: Endpoint policy updated (temp). Flow logs show ACCEPT to private-ca from infra-cert-proxy IPs. I'm requesting security to allow the boundary exception; they acknowledged.

ayana: Sampling bumped to 100% and autoscaling paused at current size. Kicking off rolling restart of 8 stuck agents to clear backoff.

rachel: Security approved a ten-minute role-boundary exception for arn:aws:iam::666:role/infra-cert-proxy and we've logged it. That should allow assumeRole to succeed.

ayana: After ~6 minutes we see ~45/64 nodes finish bootstrap and join. Remaining ones were in long backoff; I'm requeueing them and restarting in 5-node batches.

billing-bot: Updated projection: after mitigation estimated extra ~140 GPU-minutes (~$210).

vince: Post-incident quick actions: 1) revert endpoint policy change to a stricter rule that includes the proxy principal explicitly (no open policy) 2) coordinate with security to make role-boundary rollouts include a canary phase when warm-pool >0 3) add a presubmit test that simulates CA endpoint access from the infra-cert-proxy flow. I'll own 1 & 3.

rachel: I'll own 2 and update the policy rollout checklist and add an automated gating check for active warm-pool instances. Also we should add a metric: cert-issuance.latency and cert-issuance.accept_rate (30s window) with alert if accept_rate <99%.

ops-bot: INC-9002 updated with owners and action items.

ayana: thanks team. Monitoring looks stable; warm-pool stopped churning and join rate back to baseline. Keeping incident open for RCA and follow-up coordination with security. :thumbsup:
